## The Role

**The role / impact**

We are looking for a Principal Engineer to join the teams behind the **Xero Accounting App (XAA), our flagship mobile experience** that helps small business owners stay on top of their finances wherever they are. You will define the standard for engineering excellence at Xero, strengthening technical capabilities and evolving the architectural direction to support our global product roadmap.

**Core Tech Stack (Non-Negotiable):** React Native, TypeScript, and cloud-native backend APIs form the foundation of this role. You will be architecting, building, and leading across all three domains as an integrated system.

You will bridge the gap between product vision, strategy, and execution, shaping the React Native technical roadmap to ensure our architectural decisions align with strategic goals. We need a leader who can solve complex mobile engineering problems at scale, seeking clarity within complexity and demonstrating smart ways to simplify while breaking down silos and driving cross-functional collaboration between mobile and backend teams.

**Initially, you will focus on**

* **React Native Excellence:** Establishing reference patterns, best practices, and architectural standards for high-performance React Native applications. Optimize for bundle size, performance, native module integration, and TypeScript-first development—raising the bar across the codebase.
* **Cross-Boundary Technical Leadership:** Leading collaboration across mobile and backend teams, ensuring API contracts are designed with mobile consumption patterns in mind, and removing friction at the feature boundary. You'll advocate for the mobile perspective in system design while owning the React Native side fully.
* **TypeScript-First:** Championing strict TypeScript practices across the React Native codebase, establishing type safety standards, and mentoring engineers on patterns that catch errors at compile time rather than at runtime.
* **Systemic Operational Excellence:** Leading strategic prevention of issues by defining frameworks for SLOs, quality standards, crash analytics, and reliability metrics specific to mobile performance and UX.
* **Capability Elevation:** Acting as a force multiplier by coaching lead engineers in React Native architecture, recruiting top React Native + TypeScript talent, and engaging with the broader React Native community.
* **API & Backend Exposure:** Practical experience working across the feature boundary with backend services and BFF/API layers. You can reason about API contracts, mobile consumption patterns, and troubleshoot integration issues—but you're not expected to be a deep backend engineer owning infrastructure, databases, or full service architecture.

Welcome to Tallinn, where Pipedrive was born.

Come and join Pipedrive’s Tallinn team!

See open positions

## About us

Pipedrive was born in Tallinn. What started as a small startup in a shared office has grown into an international company with an entire building in Tallinn’s vibrant WoHo quarter. Today, Tallinn is home to our engineering and product hub, where 300+ team members from 30+ nationalities work together – many of them engineers.

Pipedrive is proud to be Estonia’s fifth unicorn and has consistently been recognized as one of the best places in the country to work since 2016, according to both the media and our employees. And we’re not just about jobs – at Pipedrive, you’ll have the chance to grow, learn and make a real impact by helping shape a product used by more than 100,000 companies worldwide.

## Our traditions

At Pipedrive, we love to celebrate the moments that matter – from birthdays and work anniversaries to promotions. One of our most beloved traditions is getting together for *Kringle*, a classic Estonian pastry, though you’ll also see pizza, donuts or pancakes make an appearance. To make sure no celebration goes unnoticed, we’ve got a kitchen-alert Slack channel to keep everyone in the loop.

Our biggest annual event is the Summer Garage – a full-day celebration that brings teams together to connect, unwind and enjoy live music performed by our very own band (and sometimes a guest artist or two).

We also host occasional hackathons and innovation accelerators to spark new ideas for improving the product and how we work together.

We believe in a balance of fun and focus. From Lightning Talks where anyone can practice their presentation skills with a topic they care about, to Sudoku tournaments and gaming challenges organized by teammates, there’s always something to get involved in.

We’re also proud to contribute to the wider community: Our team actively supports the local engineering, product and HR scenes in Estonia by hosting in-house meetups, participating in conferences and speaking at events.

Staying active outside of work is also a big part of our culture. Whether it's a friendly game of table tennis, a disc golf match or a padel session – one of the most popular sports among our Tallinn team – there's always fun going on.

## Where you’ll find us

You’ll find us in Tallinn’s modern WoHo district, where our custom-designed office makes it easy to feel at home. Each of our eight themed floors – park, nature, sports, IT, music, art, movies and culture – is fully immersive. Whether you’re jamming on the music floor’s instruments or exploring the art gallery, there’s something for everyone.

The heart of the office is our all-hands area, where people gather for a coffee or something else from our well stocked kitchens. Our Prague office is a dynamic engineering hub buzzing with diversity, culture and innovation. Home to 30+ talented teammates from more than ten countries, it’s a space designed to spark ideas and foster collaboration.

# Software Team Lead

## At Nosto, we’re on a mission to make every impression relevant. We’re a global leader in the booming eCommerce space and work with amazing customers.

#### **Who are we?**

At Nosto, we’re on a mission to make every impression relevant. We’re a global leader in the booming e-commerce space and work with amazing customers like FIGS, Muji, Kylie Cosmetics and O’Neill. Every day we process data for thousands of merchants and tens of millions of shoppers.

Using behavioral data, deep store integrations, machine learning, and automated workflows, the Nosto Commerce Experience Platform helps retailers deliver personalized commerce experiences at scale. We serve more than 64 billion personalized experiences annually, with traffic peaks reaching millions of requests per minute.

As an Software Team Lead at Nosto, you’ll help solve one of the biggest challenges in retail today: delivering authentic, relevant shopping experiences that drive results. We believe in listening closely to customers and achieving big things by making steady progress every day.

#### What you’ll be working on

You’ll lead the Personalization engineering team and stay deeply involved in the technical work. The Personalization team is responsible for some of the flagship areas of the Nosto platform, such as Product Recommendations and our Agentic AI features like Ask Huginn. This is a genuinely hands-on role: you’ll spend a meaningful part of your time building, reviewing, and shipping alongside the team, while also steering direction and delivery.

The team is experienced and long-tenured, with strong domain knowledge and a pragmatic way of working. Your scope will touch infrastructure, backend, and frontend development. You won’t be alone in that, though — you’ll work closely with platform and specialist teams such as Data & AI, Product Design, Site Reliability, and Core Frontend to hit your goals.

You’ll partner with Product Management, Customer Success, and Technical Solution Managers to ensure we deliver clear customer value. We operate with low hierarchy and low politics, and we expect leaders to drive change when something can be improved. ## THE ROLE AND THE TEAM

The ZEOS B2B Platform is the engine that enables our partners to integrate and grow within the Zalando ecosystem. As a Frontend Engineer, you will join a cross-functional team dedicated to building our B2B Portal and specialized Portal Applications. You will work in an API-first environment where your goal is to turn complex business logic into intuitive, high-performance user interfaces.

In this role, you will work alongside Senior Engineers and Product Managers to implement new features and improve our frontend landscape. You will be part of a culture that values technical curiosity and operational responsibility. At ZEOS, we believe in "You Write It, You Run It," meaning you will be involved in the entire journey of your code, from the first line of code written to monitoring its performance in production.

## INCLUSIVE BY DESIGN

If you think you have what it takes, we encourage you to apply even if you don't meet every single requirement. You may just be the right candidate for this or other roles!

At Zalando, our vision is to be the leading pan-European ecosystem for fashion and lifestyle e-commerce – one that thrives on diversity and is truly inclusive by design. We believe that diverse teams fuel innovation and creativity, and we actively seek out talent from all backgrounds.

We actively seek to reduce bias in our hiring and employment processes, focusing on your qualifications, skills, and contributions. To support this, we kindly ask that you refrain from including personal details such as your photo, age, or marital status in your CV, ensuring a fair and equitable evaluation based solely on your abilities and potential.

We are committed to providing an exceptional and accessible candidate experience for everyone. If you require any accommodations to support you throughout the hiring process, please let us know – we are here to assist you.

Discover more about our commitment to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace: https://jobs.zalando.com/en/our-culture/diversity-and-inclusion

## WHAT WE’D LOVE YOU TO DO (AND LOVE DOING)

* **Develop High-Quality Features**: Build and maintain user-facing features using React and TypeScript, ensuring code is clean, tested, and follows our established Design System (DS).
* **Contribute to Modern Architectures**: Work within a Micro Frontend (MFE) and SPA environment, helping us build modular components that are easy to integrate and scale.

# Senior Frontend Engineer (m/f/d)

Remote, Leer

Full-time

Permanent employee

## Role

Everything our users see runs on Next.js and React, and we'd like to hand it to you: the design system it's built from, how fast it loads, and whether everyone can actually use it.

You'll work closely with our software architects, product owners, and fellow developers: code reviews, pair programming, and the technical decisions that stick around.

## Your mission

* You build and maintain our design system in React and Tailwind, so features stay consistent instead of being rebuilt from scratch each time.
* You own frontend performance in Next.js 16 — rendering strategy, bundle size, and what people actually experience on a mediocre connection.
* You treat accessibility as a default, not as cleanup at the end of the sprint.
* You develop the Node.js layer (Express.js, Nest.js) between the UI and our backend services, with Redis where caching helps.
* You push for clean code and automated testing, and you share what you know instead of sitting on it.
* You use coding agents as part of your daily workflow — directing their work, reviewing their output, and fixing what doesn't hold up. Writing code matters; knowing what good code looks like matters more.

## Your profile

* You've spent several years building production frontends with React, Next.js, and TypeScript.
* You know Tailwind CSS well and you've managed client-side state with Zustand.
* You test what you build — unit and component tests with Vitest, end-to-end tests with Playwright.
* You're comfortable in Node.js with Express.js or Nest.js, and working against APIs from a microservices backend.
* You work well in agile teams (Scrum/Kanban), you write clearly, and you're comfortable in English.
* You have a degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field — or the experience that makes one unnecessary.

## Nice to have

* You've worked with AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform. We're not in the cloud yet, so this is a plus, not a requirement.

## How you think

We care as much about how you approach a problem as about which frameworks you know. You look past the edges of your own ticket: you notice when a fix really belongs in a different service, you question a process once it has stopped making sense, and you judge your work by whether the whole system got better — not by whether your part shipped. "Not my code" isn't a sentence we use much around here.

## Why us?

You're joining at a point where the engineering foundations themselves are being rebuilt around AI-native workflows — not retrofitted onto legacy decisions, but designed now, while the architecture is still being shaped. That means you don't inherit someone else's five-year-old choices: you help make the calls on how services are split, where AI agents fit into the workflow, and what "good" looks like technically around here.
